description: A young woman with long dark hair films herself indoors with a golden retriever sitting beside her against a grey upholstered headboard. For most of the clip she wears a dark blue t-shirt, smiling at the camera and making expressive hand gestures while an upbeat Hindi pop song plays in the background. The dog remains stationary, panting happily with its tongue out and wearing a small orange tag on its collar. Midway through, there is a quick transition where she changes into a colorful floral sleeveless top and adds silver bangles and earrings. She then places a purple headband with two glittery starfish decorations on the dog's head. She continues to smile, talk, and gesture toward the camera and the dog, occasionally looking at the dog affectionately. The video ends with her leaning in to kiss the dog on the nose before the screen fades to black. The overall tone is cheerful, warm, and focused on the bond between owner and pet.
